maria (PM): Starting a focused thread to finalize tenant-staged rollout gates for model-v2. We need: per-tenant flags, auto-fallback rules, canary shadowing, and a short launch checklist.

sam (eng): Per-tenant + global master. For Dedicated use pool-level toggles. Private must default to local-only toggles unless customer opts into remote.

lee (sre): Autofallback metrics proposed: p95 delta, 5xx rate, token backlog. Example triggers: p95_delta > 20% for 10m OR 5xx_rate > 1% for 5m => fallback. Expose knobs per-tenant.

olivia (prod-ops): I'll build API + console view. Flag schema idea: name, scope (global/tenant/pool), strategy (percent/staged/list), stages array. Console shows stage, pct, last changer, and rollback button. Private toggles require signature verification.

anjali (cs): Customer asks: beta tenants want rollback guarantees + named on-call. We'll provide a one-pager and a 48h notice window. Offer opt-out within first 2 hours after traffic inclusion.

david (security): For Private toggles require KMS-signed requests, timestamp+nonce to prevent replay, and local audit retention for SOC2. No unsigned remote toggles.

sam (eng): Operational plan: 48h shadowing (sampled traffic), run A/B evals on curated prompt set, rehearse automatic rollback in staging. Also validate quantized kernel fallbacks for Dedicated.

lee (sre): Pre-canary rehearsals: manual+auto rollback test, SLA spike sim, cache warm-up pacing. Add an emergency global kill-switch.

maria (PM): Draft launch checklist: 48h shadowing OK, p95_delta <=15% US canary, 5xx <0.5%, audit logs enabled for Private, rollback automation tested, customer comms ready.

deploy-bot: canary-config pushed to staging (sha:0412) 9;running smoke and shadow hooks9;.

maria (PM): Owners: Olivia console/API, Sam infra+shadowing, Lee runbook+rehearsal, Anjali customer comms, David security checklist. Rehearsal Wed 9am. Post any objections by EOD.
